   161	def forward_packet(flow, header, payload, enabled):
   162	    """Classify and forward one packet; returns the packet result dict."""
   163	    size = flow['H']
   164	    hops = flow['N']
   165	    tpos = flow['tpos']
   166	    qpos = flow['qpos']
   167	    if not enabled:
   168	        mode = 'ip'
   169	        reason = 'disabled'
   170	    else:
   171	        template = flow['template']
   172	        mismatch = False
   173	        for i in flow['kpos']:
   174	            if header[i] != template[i]:
   175	                mismatch = True
   176	                break
   177	        if mismatch:
   178	            mode = 'ip'
   179	            reason = 'mismatch'
   180	        elif header[qpos] > 7:
   181	            mode = 'ip'
   182	            reason = 'qos'
   183	        else:
   184	            mode = 'mpls'
   185	            reason = 'compressed'
   186	
   187	    ttl0 = header[tpos]
   188	    payload_hex = payload.hex()
   189	    if mode == 'mpls':
   190	        residue = bytes(header[i] for i in flow['dpos'])
   191	        residue_hex = residue.hex()
   192	        tc = header[qpos]
   193	        labels = flow['labels']
   194	        wire = []
   195	        for i in range(hops):
   196	            ttl = ttl0 - i
   197	            if ttl <= 0:
   198	                break
   199	            word = (labels[i] << 12) | (tc << 9) | 0x100 | ttl
   200	            wire.append(word.to_bytes(4, 'big').hex() + residue_hex + payload_hex)
   201	        byte_hops = len(wire) * (4 + len(residue) + len(payload))
   202	        if len(wire) == hops:
   203	            rebuilt = bytearray(size)
   204	            template = flow['template']
   205	            for i in flow['kpos']:
   206	                rebuilt[i] = template[i]
   207	            for j, i in enumerate(flow['dpos']):
   208	                rebuilt[i] = residue[j]
   209	            for i in flow['zpos']:
   210	                rebuilt[i] = 0
   211	            rebuilt[qpos] = tc
   212	            rebuilt[tpos] = ttl0 - (hops - 1)
   213	            delivered = rebuilt.hex() + payload_hex
   214	        else:
   215	            delivered = None
   216	    else:
   217	        prefix = header[:tpos].hex()
   218	        suffix = header[tpos + 1:].hex()
   219	        wire = []
   220	        for i in range(hops):
   221	            ttl = ttl0 - i
   222	            if ttl <= 0:
   223	                break
   224	            wire.append(prefix + '%02x' % ttl + suffix + payload_hex)
   225	        byte_hops = len(wire) * (size + len(payload))
   226	        delivered = wire[-1] if len(wire) == hops else None
   227	    return {'mode': mode, 'reason': reason, 'wire': wire,
   228	            'delivered': delivered, 'byte_hops': byte_hops}

   231	def run_replay(caps, flows, events):
   232	    need(isinstance(events, list))
   233	    need(len(events) <= 20000)
   234	    tables = {node: {} for node in caps}
   235	    enabled = set()
   236	    enabled_labels = {node: {} for node in caps}
   237	    results = []
   238	    total_bytes = 0
   239	
   240	    for event in events:
   241	        need(isinstance(event, dict))
   242	        op = event.get('op')
   243	        need(isinstance(op, str))
   244	
   245	        if op == 'put':
   246	            need(set(event.keys()) == {'op', 'flow', 'node'})
   247	            fid = want_id(event['flow'])
   248	            need(fid in flows)
   249	            node = want_id(event['node'])
   250	            flow = flows[fid]
   251	            need(node in flow['path_index'])
   252	            label = flow['labels'][flow['path_index'][node]]
   253	            table = tables[node]
   254	            if table.get(label) == fid:
   255	                results.append({'status': 'ok'})
   256	            elif label in enabled_labels[node]:
   257	                results.append({'status': 'busy'})
   258	            elif label not in table and len(table) >= caps[node]:
   259	                results.append({'status': 'full'})
   260	            else:
   261	                table[label] = fid
   262	                results.append({'status': 'ok'})
   263	
   264	        elif op == 'enable':
   265	            need(set(event.keys()) == {'op', 'flow'})
   266	            fid = want_id(event['flow'])
   267	            need(fid in flows)
   268	            flow = flows[fid]
   269	            ready = True
   270	            for i, node in enumerate(flow['path']):
   271	                if tables[node].get(flow['labels'][i]) != fid:
   272	                    ready = False
   273	                    break
   274	            if ready:
   275	                if fid not in enabled:
   276	                    enabled.add(fid)
   277	                    for i, node in enumerate(flow['path']):
   278	                        enabled_labels[node][flow['labels'][i]] = fid
   279	                results.append({'status': 'ok'})
   280	            else:
   281	                results.append({'status': 'unready'})
   282	
   283	        elif op == 'disable':
   284	            need(set(event.keys()) == {'op', 'flow'})
   285	            fid = want_id(event['flow'])
   286	            need(fid in flows)
   287	            if fid in enabled:
   288	                enabled.discard(fid)
   289	                flow = flows[fid]
   290	                for i, node in enumerate(flow['path']):
   291	                    holder = enabled_labels[node]
   292	                    if holder.get(flow['labels'][i]) == fid:
   293	                        del holder[flow['labels'][i]]
   294	            results.append({'status': 'ok'})
   295	
   296	        elif op == 'reset':
   297	            need(set(event.keys()) == {'op'})
   298	            enabled.clear()
   299	            for holder in enabled_labels.values():
   300	                holder.clear()
   301	            results.append({'status': 'ok'})
   302	
   303	        elif op == 'packet':
   304	            need(set(event.keys()) == {'op', 'flow', 'header', 'payload'})
   305	            fid = want_id(event['flow'])
   306	            need(fid in flows)
   307	            flow = flows[fid]
   308	            header_hex = want_hex(event['header'], nonempty=True)
   309	            need(len(header_hex) == 2 * flow['H'])
   310	            payload_hex = want_hex(event['payload'])
   311	            need(len(payload_hex) // 2 <= 2048)
   312	            total_bytes += len(header_hex) // 2 + len(payload_hex) // 2
   313	            need(total_bytes <= MAX_REPLAY_PACKET_BYTES)
   314	            results.append(forward_packet(flow, bytes.fromhex(header_hex),
   315	                                          bytes.fromhex(payload_hex),
   316	                                          fid in enabled))
   317	
   318	        else:
   319	            raise Invalid()
   320	
   321	    table_list = []
   322	    for node in sorted(tables):
   323	        table = tables[node]
   324	        for label in sorted(table):
   325	            table_list.append({'node': node, 'label': label, 'flow': table[label]})
   326	    return {'results': results, 'active': sorted(enabled), 'tables': table_list}
